decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall be carried on only by Mrs Bhullar and shall be for a limited period being the period of  1    year from the date of this letter, or the period during which the premises are occupied byMrs Bhullar whichever is the shorter.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. __GSB/P 001_______ and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
description: Continued use of part of ground floor of dwellinghouse as a health and beauty consultancy.
